full_judgment: 2. The petitioner as plaintiff instituted the aforesaid Title Suit against the present opposite party Nos. 1-3 for declaration of title and recovery of possession after evicting the defendants-opposite parties from the suit land on the allegations, inter alia, that the plaintiff got settlement of suit land along with other lands measuring 3 acres from the Government under the Settlement Case No. 26251/50-60 by executing a kabuliyat on 12-6-66 and got possession therein from the Surveyor of the Government ; that the defendant opposite party wanted to purchase the suit land from the plaintiff but as the plaintiff did not agree to sell the defendants dispossessed the plaintiff from the land in suit in the first part of Magh 1374 BS constructing but and digging ditches and excavating tank in the suit land; that the defendants also threatened him to dispossess from the remaining vacant land.
